source_rules: C useupall consumes all obj->quan. setnotworn -> freeinv -> obfree(NULL). useup decrement-one is a separate branch.

onbill matches bo_id==o_id in a creditor bill. For a matching bill/no merge, obfree sets useup=TRUE, clears object unpaid only for presentation, retains same object/id/quantity on billobjs and returns before dealloc_obj.

add_to_billobjs requires OBJ_FREE, stops attached timers, marks OBJ_ONBILL and clears in_use/bypass. Bill record price and bquan are unchanged. bp_to_obj resolves useup via billobjs; find_oid excludes billobjs.
No matching bill/no merge reaches dealloc_obj; its timed/light/reference/Lua/staging branches are LIFE/OB04 obligations. Rust consumed bill storage models liability retention, not a C allocator.

doinvbill uses stored price*bquan for useup; object quantity is retained description state, not a reason to erase bill or reduce liability. Charge-use debit is separate and must not be converted to/remitted by disposal.
native_gaps: SimulationWorld/StoredLevel unpaid_items is Vec<(ItemId,u32)> base cost only. get_unpaid_cost recalculates current hero price; there is no useup/bquan/frozen-price/creditor/consumed owner.
Arena.destroy_item removes generation and registers artifact; it cannot retain billing responsibility. Limbo is still an arena record and is not consumed bill storage.
forget_rot_corpse_references clears wield/quiver and remove_unpaid. It must not be reused for billed wand retirement.

handle_pay visits carried items only and ignores consumed debts; economy_ledger clones only live tuples. These remain known DG06 gaps; new outstanding_bills must expose retained liabilities independently.

pack_current_level removes live arena records into StoredLevel and restore remints IDs. Global live receipt terms must retain cached full ItemId then remap only at cached restoration; consumed historical identity never enters remap. No StoredLevel field needed.

representation.owner: Add #[serde(default)] billing: BillingState to SimulationWorld only. Types live in world.rs. No new StoredLevel, ItemRecord, action, Ruleset or arena fields. Global live_terms resolves against either active arena or exactly one StoredLevel.items record by full current generation.
representation.BillingState: { live_terms: Vec<(ItemId,BillTerms)>, consumed: Vec<ConsumedBillRecord> }; no counter or new identity allocator. Existing unpaid_items remains the compatibility live ledger.
representation.BillTerms: { billed_quantity: Option<u32>, unit_price: Option<u32>, creditor: Option<BillCreditor>, legacy_base_cost: u32 }; None is explicit unavailable historical fact, never zero/paid. BillCreditor is a source receipt identity (branch,depth,shopkeeper original full ActorId); it is a historical trace, not an active arena lookup. Full account mapping belongs DG06.
representation.ConsumedBillRecord: { origin: ItemId (full generation), object: ItemRecord (owned clone moved out of arena, location normalized Limbo solely inside detached record), terms: BillTerms }; membership means useup. Snapshot preserves explicit ItemDefinition, name, artifact, BUC, spe, recharged, weight and whole quantity. No ItemLocation enum extension.
representation.identity: Borrow the owned Arc<Ruleset>; explicit ItemDefinition uses item_for_definition, never display-name/static fallback. Legacy None uses existing exact owned lookup. Unknown/changed explicit identity is a failure before mutation. Canonical/custom and renamed display fixtures required. Existing item_for_definition owner is crates/nethacked-data/src/ruleset.rs:693, ItemDefinition owner crates/nethacked-types/src/lib.rs:863; reuse accepted S1/API1 identity contract, no new definition implementation.
representation.liability: Known receipt price and billed_quantity are frozen at admission and unchanged at consumption; total checked in u64 within selected LP64 long supported domain. If missing, return UnresolvedTerms{base,current_consumed_quantity,...}; never approximate price*bquan or invent source o_id/account. Current object quantity is exact consumed amount, distinct from unknown historical bquan.
representation.outputs: Vec insertion order matches API admission/consumption order and survives serde; use BTree ordering for keyed views when needed. No HashMap iteration into observable state, no float or static definition tables.
invariants: Exactly one live tuple for a billed item; at most one matching live receipt; any duplicate/inconsistent input rejected before disposal.
Retained origin is historical, never a selectable/live carried handle. A replacement generation cannot inherit a consumed receipt.
Billed consume moves live obligation into exactly one consumed record before compatibility tuple removal becomes observable; unit price/bquan unchanged.
Unbilled consume creates no liability and removes entire arena stack.
Consumed record never cleared by remove_unpaid, rot cleanup, stair packing, timer reconciliation or failed/duplicate request; settlement needs separate explicit accepted source route.
Existing legacy ledger without receipt may consume into UnknownLegacy terms, preserving tuple base and snapshot exactly; this proves conservation/compatibility, not exact C historical amount.
Source-known whole-only fixtures require bquan==current q; known partial/merge/contents branches reject UnsupportedBillingScope until named successor accepted.
Repeated admission never replaces frozen terms, even for identical terms; receipt existence returns ReceiptAlreadyRecorded atomically.

Public ledger clearing cannot orphan an admitted receipt. Pay cannot charge projected prices or settle any obligation while live/consumed billing state exists; refusal preserves active and cached ownership.

api.admission: record_bill_terms requires existing exactly-one unpaid tuple, same full live carried generation, validated owned wand definition, q>0, supported known receipt quantity/price. It records source-provided receipt; does not implement get_cost or create shop merchandise. Legacy absence stays absent. Receipts are prescribed authoritative fixture inputs, not a claim that record_bill_terms implements C get_cost. Full source receipt creation is DG06-bill-history/PRE; pure transfer acceptance must say so. Repeated admission: after full-generation/unique-ledger/owned-definition validation, an existing receipt returns Err(BillError::ReceiptAlreadyRecorded) for both byte/equality-identical and changed BillTerms, before validating proposed replacement terms. No upsert, replacement, reconciliation or second admission succeeds. Duplicate existing receipts remain DuplicateLedger. All receipt fields including creditor and legacy_base_cost are frozen; terms changes require a separately accepted DG06 route.
api.success: WholeDisposal::{Unbilled{origin},RetainedBilled{origin}}. BillView includes object identity, consumed q, known terms or UnresolvedTerms, outstanding/useup, and checked known total; it must not require arena existence. outstanding_bills includes live tuples (with known receipt or explicit unavailable terms) and detached consumed records; live is_unpaid false after retained consumption does not mean settled. Ordered live views then consumed views use stable Vec order. No payment handler delegation.
api.errors: AlreadyConsumed (exact retained origin), StaleItem (including old generation), NotCarried, InvalidDefinition, ZeroQuantity, DuplicateLedger, InvalidReceipt, UnsupportedBillingScope, LifecycleReferencesPresent; all no mutation/no draws/events/time. Do not relax prior S1 selection checks. ReceiptAlreadyRecorded (identical or changed repeated admission); SettlementDeferred (new typed clearing preflight); identical atomic failure guarantees apply.
api.preflight: Public disposal is a native API fixture route for carried wand with no equipment/timer/current-operation references; reject referenced items. Validate item/identity/ledger/terms and supported domain before any mutation; allocate/move snapshot then commit without callbacks or fallible operations. Ordinary allocation failure is not recoverable transactional gameplay.
api.LIFE_composition: Private prepare_whole_disposal validates immutable generation+record+ledger/terms. LIFE validates all represented references and borrows/cleans them without callbacks or RNG; private commit_whole_disposal consumes prepared same-state ticket once in same &mut-world operation. Ticket cannot be serialized or externally constructed; revalidate if intervening mutation. LIFE owns exact timer/equipment cleanup allowlist; this packet grants none.
api.failure_boundaries: No charge, RNG, time, UI message, payment or equipment mutation in billing API. Do not erase liability on invalid identity, stale ticket, duplicate ledger, retained origin, unknown receipt, cache/load error. Unknown receipt is retained successful liability, not an error that downgrades to unbilled. Invalid input loads return LoadError::Json before catchup timers. Ruleset mismatch preserves existing LoadError and must precede billing reconciliation.

clearing_policy.typed_api: Add try_remove_unpaid(&mut self,id:ItemId)->Result<(),BillError>. Return SettlementDeferred if this exact full-generation ID has live terms or is a consumed origin; otherwise retain existing tuple removal and return Ok(()). No new terms are settled here.
clearing_policy.existing_remove_unpaid: Preserve public remove_unpaid(&mut self,id:ItemId)->() signature. Delegate to try_remove_unpaid; SettlementDeferred deliberately produces a complete no-op, observable as unchanged tuple/receipt/views. No logging, event or ignored successful removal. New callers needing a result use the typed API. Frozen receipt is never dropped or rewritten. Consumed records never removed.
clearing_policy.Pay: If billing.live_terms or billing.consumed is nonempty anywhere active/cached/global, refuse the entire Pay request with an empty returned event Vec and complete world unchanged. Add guard at the very start of step_player_action for requested ActionAst::Pay BEFORE player clone, reconcile_equipment, forced Wait, scheduler/ticks/RNG and record_events; add same guard at start of handle_pay for direct crate-local callers. No partial payment, player_gold debit, pricing computation, settlement message, time, event or fee. Empty Vec is the defined existing Vec-returning refusal result. New private predicate billing_settlement_deferred is read-only.
clearing_policy.legacy: When BillingState is completely empty, remove_unpaid/try_remove_unpaid and Pay take the original tuple-based path unchanged, including existing events, scheduler and pricing. This is a field-state predicate for every world, never a vanilla, golden or test exemption. Legacy tuples alone still have unknown historical terms. A newly retained UnknownLegacy consumed record is outstanding liability and blocks Pay.
clearing_policy.views: get_unpaid_cost stays the existing current-price projection, not a frozen receipt valuation or settlement authorization. is_unpaid/economy_ledger retain every refused live tuple; detached consumed liabilities are exposed by outstanding_bills, not represented as inventory tuples. No price getter/EconomyLedger/price-check body edit proposed.
clearing_policy.disposal: Private prepared disposal commit moves admitted terms to consumed and removes its live tuple/terms in one commit; it must not call the refusal wrapper as a settlement route. After direct clearing/Pay refusal, subsequent public disposal retains the original full terms and total. After consumption Pay still refuses; direct remove_unpaid(origin) changes nothing. No public lifecycle activation follows.
